subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close the conflicting open fork PR and queue or sponsor a narrow current-runtime replacement for this issue?
rationale: The bug is clear, but the open fork PR still references this issue and is not a viable landing path; choosing whether to close, adopt, or replace that PR is a maintainer workflow decision.

options.title: Close fork and queue replacement
options.body: Close the conflicting fork PR as obsolete and allow a narrow fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt the fork branch
options.body: A maintainer could manually salvage the useful idea, but most of the branch would need to be replaced because it targets removed code and carries unrelated docs edits.

options.title: Wait for fork author
options.body: Keep waiting for the fork author to rework the branch, accepting that the source-reproducible Telegram bug remains open meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Close fork and queue replacement
recommendation.body: Close the conflicting fork PR as obsolete and allow a narrow fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the native approval lifecycle and are the strongest history signal for the final-action seam involved here.
